source_text.body:
Build your own video-editing agents on a canvas
Mosaic lets you create and run multimodal video-editing agents in a node-based editor.
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
The page describes Mosaic as a canvas for agentic video editing. You run edits on autopilot and make several variants from the same raw footage to A/B test. You can then open a familiar timeline editor to adjust things by hand.
How it went
The page gives no results, numbers, or limitations. It is a product description only.
Worth knowing
The source is only a landing page with no detail on setup, cost, or how the nodes work, so check the product itself before relying on it.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
Build me a small node-based video-editing pipeline in [my project folder] using [ffmpeg or another tool]. Nodes should include trim, caption, and combine steps that I can chain, and I'll describe the video as [what I want]. Finished means running the pipeline on [sample clip] produces an output file, and you should ask before overwriting any existing files.
Original source: https://mosaic.so
